title: Triple damage
wikitext:
'''Triple damage''' is an effect that causes a [[hit]] to deal triple its damage. Triple damage overrides and does not stack with [[double damage]].

==Mechanics==
* Chance to deal triple damage is additive.
* Additional % chance exceeding 100% has no effect. For example, {{il|The Annihilating Light}} with any additional source of triple damage will have no further effect.
* The damage increase is applied after all other modifiers.<ref name="works with critical strikes" />
* Triple damage is currently hit-only and '''does not''' apply to [[Ailment]] damage or [[Damage over time]].
* Triple damage overrides double damage<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/iu4b8m/heres_a_new_unique_item_available_in_the_heist/g5isq2d/?context=3</ref>; a hit that does triple damage will never also do double damage.
